sources.name: 全国音ゲー設置店舗情報wiki (otogesetchi)
sources.example_data_quote: タイトーステーション渋谷店: 弐寺LM2台、ポップンPPM2台、SDVX3台、DDR金筐体1台、ギタドラAM各1台 / maimai1台、チュウニ金筐体3台 / 太鼓4台 (最終確認26/6中旬). GiGO渋谷宮益坂: オンゲキ4台、maimai2台、チュウニ金筐体5台、太鼓4台. シルクハット秋葉原: 弐寺LM合計15台(7F+8F)、SDVXVM11台、チュウニ金10台、maimai5台、オンゲキ4台、太鼓5台.
sources.adds_over_current: Per-cab counts and cab model (LM/金/PPM/AM) that official presence sources do not always surface cleanly; rare/offline titles (DIVA at 高田馬場ミカド, パカパカ, グルコス, テトコネ); access notes. Tokyo 都心 page updated 2026-08-04. Compared GiGO渋谷宮益坂: map has ongeki count 1 vs wiki 4; silkhat iidx count 1 vs wiki ~15 LM. Outside Tokyo many prefecture pages still thin (wiki self-describes as 設立したばかり).
sources.note: Best Japan analogue to hkarcade.fandom for multi-game cab lists. Prefecture-split pages; Tokyo strongest. Copyright notice forbids bulk republication - scrape for merge only with care. Completeness uneven nationally.

sources.name: 太鼓の達人 設置店舗情報 (Bandai Namco official)
sources.example_data_quote: 東京都(23区) 124件. アドアーズ浅草: 2台設置 / 東京都 台東区 浅草 1-42-4 パシフィックコート浅草B1・1F. namco秋葉原: 8台. シルクハット秋葉原: 5台. GiGO渋谷宮益坂: 4台. URL pattern: /S12/list?area=JP-01..JP-47 and /S12/detail?loc_id=...
sources.adds_over_current: Official Taiko presence + cab counts nationwide. Map has only 286/1397 JP venues with taiko; 122 other-only are almost all ZIv-only stubs. Example: Adores Asakusa (id 6541) is games=['other'] with no taiko; Taiko official lists 2 cabs at same address. Can reclassify many other-only and crane-corner ZIv stubs that actually run Taiko.
sources.note: Not ALL.Net/eagate/ZIv. Highest-value single-game official source for Japan. Cab count note: terminals may be included in totals. Detail page HTML is thin; list pages carry 台数.

sources.name: オトマップ (OTOMAP)
sources.example_data_quote: ラウンドワンスタジアム 函館店 /shops/1: 住所 北海道函館市西桔梗町 848番地11; 営業 10:00〜翌04:00; user post 2022/09/08: チュウニズム：金筐体２台、銀筐体２台 / オンゲキ：120/240/360GP. GiGO 新宿歌舞伎町 /shops/3186: 住所 東京都新宿区歌舞伎町１丁目２１−１; 10:00〜23:00. Filter lists IIDX LM, SDVX VM, CHUNITHM, maimai, オンゲキ, 太鼓, GROOVE COASTER, CHRONO CIRCLE, etc.
sources.adds_over_current: Map UI over music-game venues with sequential /shops/{id} (IDs observed to 3186+). Hours + occasional user-reported cab models/GP prices. Does not reliably show structured cab lists without user posts (設置筐体 often empty). Overlaps heavily with allnet+eagate for presence; best as hours/count enrichment and discovery of offline/rare titles.
sources.note: RUNTEQ portfolio product (2022). Login/edit community model. JS-heavy map; venue pages are HTML-scrapable. Do not confuse with unrelated Taiwan food company otomapcorp.

sources.name: ラウンドワン アミューズメント ゲーム機検索 (Japan)
sources.example_data_quote: DANCE aROUND (type=48): 設置店舗一覧 includes 函館店, 旭川店, 大宮店, 池袋店, ダイバーシティ東京プラザ店, 福岡天神店, 沖縄 stores, etc. Other type IDs: 太鼓新筺体 type=31 全店設置済み, CHUNITHM Mate=34, maimai CiRCLE PLUS=35, SDVX VM=38, IIDX LM=39, オンゲキ Re:Fresh=42, ポラリスコード=44, MUSIC DIVER=47, ノスタルジア=56. Shop nav lists ~100 JP stores (函館..沖縄南風原).
sources.adds_over_current: Japan Round1 only (Round1 USA is already a map source; this JP locator is not). Per-title store lists for chain-exclusive or chain-heavy games (DANCE aROUND, MUSIC DIVER, CHRONO CIRCLE). Can invert type lists into per-store game sets. Does not give cab counts. Map already has eagate/allnet for many R1 stores (e.g. ラウンドワン函館 id 7380) so primary gain is exclusives + confirmation.
sources.note: URL patterns: type/index.cgi, type/detail.cgi?type=N, shop/detail.cgi?shop=N (shop detail page HTML was flaky in fetch; type detail works). Distinct from Round1 USA scraper.

sources.name: GiGO お店情報サイト 店舗検索
sources.example_data_quote: GiGO渋谷宮益坂: 営業 10:00〜23:30 daily; ゲームの種類 includes 音楽ゲーム; listed titles include オンゲキ Re:Fresh Act.2, CHUNITHM Mate, maimai でらっくす CiRCLE PLUS, SOUND VOLTEX ∇, beatmania IIDX 33. Filter /shops?game=music_game and /shops?area=13.
sources.adds_over_current: Official hours + named music titles on store pages. SEGA titles already largely from ALL.Net; Konami titles on GiGO pages can corroborate eagate. No cab counts. Photo/hours useful; brand forbids embedding many store photos per project README.
sources.note: Next.js site; slug URLs /shops/{slug}. music_game filter is the useful scrape entry. Not a cab inventory wiki.

sources.name: 北海道『音ゲー』ろけ情報 4thTRAX
sources.example_data_quote: Area pages ar=00..09 (札幌中央/北/南/東/西, 道央, 道東, 道北, 道南, オホーツク). Per-store tables with version + count (e.g. CHUNITHM VERSE x6, maimai PRiSM PLUS x2, 太鼓 ニジイロ x2), GP prices, last updated by named contributors. Site updates through 2026-08-04 (CHUNITHM Mate notes 2026.6/21).
sources.adds_over_current: Deepest Hokkaido-only cab/price/version detail; richer than map game_counts for many 道内 venues. Encoding is Shift_JIS (set PYTHONIOENCODING / decode correctly). Regional only, not national.
sources.note: Classic CGI location DB. Still community-maintained in 2026. Pattern list.cgi?ar=NN.

sources.name: ゲームセンターデータベース かみはて (kamihate)
sources.example_data_quote: Prefecture index (北海道..沖縄) with venue slugs. Updates into 2026 (東京レジャーランド吉祥寺 2026.06.16, BIGBANG北見 2026.03.09). Title lists cover IIDX, SDVX, pop'n, maimai, チュウニ, オンゲキ, 太鼓, PIU, GROOVE COASTER, etc. Owner states only personally visited shops get full detail pages.
sources.adds_over_current: High-quality visited-shop notes + equipment tags (録画機 list). Not a complete national inventory; sparse outside owner travel paths. Secondary to otogesetchi/Taiko for fill rate.
sources.note: Personal database, not crowd wiki. Use as corroboration not primary national crawl.

summary:
Japan is already the best-covered country on Arcade Maps (ALL.Net + e-amusement + ZIv; 1397 venues, 122 other-only ZIv stubs). Unlike HK (hkarcade.fandom filled empty ZIv), Japan needs enrichment more than discovery: cab counts, Taiko (not on ALL.Net/eagate), hours, and reclassifying other-only stubs that still have Taiko or rare cabs.

Searched JA terms: ゲーセン, 音ゲー 設置店舗, 台数, 店舗一覧, ろけ情報, 音楽ゲーム マップ; plus bemaniwiki external links.

Top finds (opened and verified live 2026-08-04):
1) 全国音ゲー設置店舗情報wiki (otogesetchi) - multi-game cab counts, Tokyo strong, national pages uneven.
2) Official 太鼓の達人 設置店舗情報 - prefecture lists + 台数; directly upgrades Adores Asakusa and similar other-only pins.
3) OTOMAP - national music-game map, /shops/{id}, hours + user cab posts.
4) Round1 Japan amusement type search - chain exclusive titles by store (not Round1 USA).
5) GiGO official shops - music titles + hours, no counts.
6) Hokkaido 4thTRAX - gold-standard regional cab/price DB, still updating 2026-08-04.
7) kamihate personal DB - limited visited set.

Context: map JP sources today are allnet/eagate/ziv only (no BemaniCN/WAHLAP). 122 other-only are nearly all src=['ziv']. Official network scrapers already cover most Konami/SEGA presence; community value is counts + Taiko + offline/rare + hours.
dead_ends: Already used (excluded as finds): SEGA ALL.Net location.am-all.net, Konami eagate facility search, ZIv, Round1 USA. four-credit.com: homepage returned empty/no scrapable content (JS SPA). otoge-map.net and gamecenter-map.com: minimal server HTML, map data not confirmed in open. リズマップ (RhythMap): iOS app only, no public web venue DB. am-net.jp/location: general game-center DB search form live but no verified multi-game cab lists opened. biglobe beatsquare 音楽ゲームデータベース: old personal DB, not reopened as primary. Akihabara 2017 hatena maps: one-off outdated. saredo-otogame and similar blogs: title explainers, not venue DBs.
